div.div: رَاكِضٌ , applied to a horse, (tropical:) Running; as also ↓ رَكُوضٌ : (K:) or the correct epithet is ↓ مَرْكُوضٌ : (S:) and ↓ رَكَّاضَةٌ signifies the same, applied to a mare. (TA.) [Hence,] بِتُّ أَرْعَى النُّجُومَ وَهْىَ رَوَاكِضُ (tropical:) I passed the night observing the stars while they moved along in the sky. (A, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
